usage: Use measured values in the component role and width named by their key. Inferred entries guide new screens. Role mappings are contextual. A null or omitted property is unspecified.

evidenceTypes.computed-css-or-dom: Read as a computed property, SVG attribute, DOM geometry or repeatable layout measurement. Coordinates and boxes are CSS px before device scaling unless noted.
evidenceTypes.source-declaration: Read from preview CSS, markup or theme configuration. The value can differ from a transformed or composited measurement.
evidenceTypes.visual-estimate: Estimated from visible structure or illustration bounds. Use as an approximate design starting point.
evidenceTypes.exact-raster-count: Counted exact sRGB pixel matches in the full capture. Alpha blends, shadows, antialiasing and artwork can add nearby colors.
evidenceTypes.inferred-for-reuse: Proposed transfer or production guidance inferred from the references. Keep it conditional on the screen role.
